Are not just accidents. <break time="0.8s" /> That night we waited. <break time="0.8s" /> At the village inn. <break time="0.8s" /> Until a single light shone. <break time="0.8s" /> From Helens window. <break time="0.8s" /> The signal that we had agreed on. <break time="0.8s" /> We crept into Julias room. <break time="0.8s" /> In the dark. <break time="0.8s" /> And Holmes whispered. <break time="0.8s" /> That we must not make a sound. <break time="0.8s" /> Or fall asleep. <break time="0.8s" /> Hour after hour passed. <break time="0.8s" /> In complete silence. <break time="0.8s" /> And I Holmes struck a match. <break time="0.8s" /> And hit hard at the bell rope. <break time="0.8s" /> With his cane. <break time="0.8s" /> Shouting, You see it, Watson.
